scope: Prepare high-frame video-reference rebuilds for Yoyo clone-heart and dharma-manifest only.
characterContract: Yoyo is a human little girl and companion, never a dog, puppy, mascot animal, or generic pet.
Use the clean-2d Yoyo identity: black straight bangs, small top bun, childlike proportions, soft friendly face, navy-and-red outfit language.
Keep the full body visible in source references unless an authored foreground effect intentionally passes in front of her.
Every frame must show grounded body weight, stable scale, and consistent head-to-body proportions.
Avoid half-body crops, floating busts, pasted faces, paw marks, collars, pet beds, pet bowls, and animal semantics.

clone-heart.label: 分身

promptFocus: One full-body Yoyo stands center, breathes in, then two translucent full-body clones split from her shoulders.
More clones fan outward in a shallow arc, then settle into a heart-shaped formation around the original.
All clones preserve the same human-child Yoyo identity and stay on the same floor plane.
No animal ears, no paws, no pet symbols, no half-body copies, no floating head copies.

extraction.frameSelection: Extract 24 evenly spaced frames, then manually replace weak frames with clearer keyframes from the same video.

layers.description: Full-body original plus full-body duplicate Yoyos; can be sampled as reference for Pixi positions or future authored clone sheet.
Small warm heart/spark burst at the final merge, kept separate from Yoyo faces and body.

acceptanceGates: Every visible Yoyo is full-body or intentionally covered by a same-frame effect; not half-body.
Clones read as the same human little girl, not animals or dolls.
Clone positions form a readable formation without drifting off the source center.
The final frame resolves cleanly so the Pixi overlay can fade out without a pop.

dharma-manifest.label: 法相

promptFocus: Full-body Yoyo stands grounded in the foreground while a large translucent guardian-like Yoyo spirit rises behind her.
The spirit is recognizably Yoyo, calm and protective, with simplified clean-2d shapes and no animal features.
Build in phases: charge ring behind feet, spirit silhouette emerges behind, foreground sigils pass in front, then all layers settle and fade.
Keep the base Yoyo original scale stable; the large spirit is an effect layer, not a resized pasted copy floating on top of her.

extraction.frameSelection: Extract 32 frames with emphasis on charge, emergence, stable spirit, foreground seal, and fade-out keyframes.

layers.description: Large translucent Yoyo-like guardian spirit placed behind the foreground Yoyo.
Foreground full-body Yoyo at normal scale, used only to validate contact and proportion.
Rune ring, lightning, and final shockwave passing in front of the character.

acceptanceGates: Foreground Yoyo stays grounded and normal-sized; the法相 is a separate back effect layer.
The spirit silhouette remains recognizably human Yoyo and not an animal/monster redesign.
Foreground rings/lightning never hide the face for more than a few frames.
The sequence has a visible charge, manifestation, stable hold, and收束.
